attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route set to 0 for all/default) and applying at runtime for all, default, eth0, and lo interfaces. Verified persistence via mandatory reboot: captured baseline boot_id, issued a safe self-scheduled reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed boot_id changed (97d73d49... -> 334743c4..., uptime 17s), and confirmed the sysctl boot service re-ran (status: started) and re-applied all hardening values after restart.
